ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida ntdsutil 'IFM' NTDS.dit extraction on domain controller
ucs.description: Hunts the textbook Rhysida domain-controller credential dump described in CISA AA23-319A — `ntdsutil.exe` invoked with `ac i ntds`, `ifm`, `create full` to copy NTDS.dit + SYSTEM hive into a staging folder ahead of offline DPAPI/secrets extraction. Rhysida (CrowdStrike: VICE SPIDER associated; Microsoft tracks the affiliate cluster overlapping with Vanilla Tempest distribution) pairs this with PsExec lateral movement, so the same chain often shows AdminShare writes within minutes.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=ntdsutil.exe (Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*") (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*create sysvol*") by host Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename host as dc_host | join type=inner dc_host [| tstats summariesonly=true count as smb_writes values(Filesystem.file_path) as staged_paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="ntds.dit" OR Filesystem.file_name="SYSTEM" OR Filesystem.file_name="SECURITY") (Filesystem.file_path="*\\temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\perflogs\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\windows\\tasks\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\$Recycle*") by host Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename host as dc_host] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Rhysida AA23-319A — ntdsutil IFM dump + NTDS.dit/SYSTEM hive staging
let Window = 7d;
let NtdsutilExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Window)
    | where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ac i ntds","activate instance ntds","ifm")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("create full","create sysvol")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project NtdsTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
              NtdsCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let StagedHives = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Window)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName in~ ("ntds.dit","SYSTEM","SECURITY","SAM")
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\temp\", @"\perflogs\", @"\windows\tasks\", @"\$Recycle", @"\programdata\", @"\users\public\")
    | project StageTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, StagedFile = FolderPath,
              StagingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              StagingCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
NtdsutilExec
| join kind=inner StagedHives on DeviceId
| where StageTime between (NtdsTime .. NtdsTime + 30m)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', StageTime, NtdsTime)
| project NtdsTime, StageTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          NtdsCmd, StagedFile, StagingProcess, StagingCmd, ParentImage, ParentCmd
| order by NtdsTime desc

    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("ac i ntds","activate instance ntds","ifm")

              NtdsCmd = CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
let StagedHives = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
    | where EventID == 4663
    | where ObjectName has_any ("\\ntds.dit","\\SYSTEM","\\SECURITY","\\SAM")
    | where ObjectName has_any ("\\Temp\\","\\PerfLogs\\","\\Windows\\Tasks\\","\\$Recycle","\\ProgramData\\","\\Users\\Public\\")
    | project StageTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, StagedFile = ObjectName,
              StagingProcess = ProcessName;
NtdsutilExec
| join kind=inner StagedHives on Computer
| where StageTime between (NtdsTime .. NtdsTime + 30m)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', StageTime, NtdsTime)
| project NtdsTime, StageTime, DelaySec, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName,
          NtdsCmd, StagedFile, StagingProcess, ParentProcessName
| order by NtdsTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Rhysida NTDS.dit Extraction via ntdsutil IFM
id: 7f9e4c2a-3b1f-4b8d-a7c9-5e6f3d2a1b9c
status: experimental
description: Detects the ntdsutil 'create full' / 'IFM' workflow that Rhysida (per CISA AA23-319A) uses to copy NTDS.dit + registry hives off a domain controller for offline credential extraction
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-319a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - threat.actor.rhysida
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
  selection_cmd_phase1:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
      - 'ifm'
  selection_cmd_phase2:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'create full'
      - 'create sysvol'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd_phase1 and selection_cmd_phase2 and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate AD admin running an authorized IFM media build for new DC promotion (verify change ticket)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) (@Image:(*\ntdsutil.exe OR *\NTDSUtil.exe OR *\NTDSUTIL.EXE) OR @NewProcessName:(*\ntdsutil.exe OR *\NTDSUtil.exe OR *\NTDSUTIL.EXE)) (@CommandLine:(*"ac i ntds"* OR *"activate instance ntds"* OR *ifm*)) (@CommandLine:(*"create full"* OR *"create sysvol"*)) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(ac i ntds|activate instance ntds|ifm)", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)(create full|create sysvol)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\\(ntds\.dit|SYSTEM|SECURITY|SAM)$/i TargetFileName=/\\(Temp|PerfLogs|Tasks|\$Recycle|ProgramData|Public)\\/i}, field=aid, key=aid, include=[TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, TargetFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Rhysida's domain-takeover playbook in CISA AA23-319A explicitly calls out `ntdsutil.exe "ac i ntds" "ifm" "create full c:\temp"` followed by SMB exfil of the IFM bundle. ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida ransomware launcher — wevtutil log clearing chained to .rhysida file rename burst
ucs.description: Catches the late-stage Rhysida detonation: per CISA AA23-319A and Microsoft's Vanilla Tempest reporting, the encryptor binary (commonly dropped as `psexec.exe`-pushed payload or as a service) executes `wevtutil cl Security/System/Application` (sometimes via `cmd.exe /c` wrapper) immediately before mass-renaming files to the `.rhysida` extension and dropping `CriticalBreachDetected.pdf` ransom notes — the log-wipe-then-encrypt sequence on the same host is the actor's terminal fingerprint.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as wipe_time values(Processes.process) as wipe_cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as wipe_parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=wevtutil.exe Processes.process="*cl *" (Processes.process="*Security*" OR Processes.process="*System*" OR Processes.process="*Application*" OR Processes.process="*Setup*") by host Processes.user _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename host as victim | join type=inner victim [| tstats summariesonly=true count as rename_events values(Filesystem.file_path) as renamed_samples min(_time) as ransom_time from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.rhysida" OR Filesystem.file_name="CriticalBreachDetected.pdf") by host Filesystem.process_name _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename host as victim | where rename_events > 25 OR like(renamed_samples,"%CriticalBreachDetected%")] | where ransom_time >= wipe_time AND (ransom_time - wipe_time) < 3600 | `security_content_ctime(wipe_time)` | `security_content_ctime(ransom_time)`
ucs.kql:
// Rhysida detonation — wevtutil cl event-log wipe immediately followed by .rhysida rename burst / ransom note drop
let Window = 7d;
let WindowSeconds = 1800; // 30 min — Rhysida wipes logs then immediately encrypts
let LogWipe = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Window)
    | where FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "cl"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Security","System","Application","Setup","Windows PowerShell")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project WipeTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              WipeCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              WipeParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              WipeParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let RhysidaFiles = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Window)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName endswith ".rhysida" or FileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"
    | summarize EncTime = min(Timestamp),
                RenameCount = count(),
                NoteDropped = countif(FileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"),
                EncProcess = any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
                EncProcessCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
                EncProcessSHA256 = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256),
                SampleFile = any(FolderPath)
             by DeviceId, DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
    | where RenameCount > 25 or NoteDropped > 0;
LogWipe
| join kind=inner RhysidaFiles on DeviceId
| where EncTime between (WipeTime .. WipeTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EncTime, WipeTime)
| project WipeTime, EncTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          WipeCmd, WipeParent, WipeParentCmd,
          EncProcess, EncProcessCmd, EncProcessSHA256,
          RenameCount, NoteDropped, SampleFile
| order by WipeTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Rhysida detonation — wevtutil log clear chained to .rhysida encryption (Sentinel SecurityEvent / DeviceFileEvents fallback)
let Window = 7d;
let WindowSeconds = 1800;
let LogWipe = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\wevtutil.exe"
    | where CommandLine has " cl " or CommandLine has " cl\""
    | where CommandLine has_any ("Security","System","Application","Setup")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project WipeTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              WipeCmd = CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
let RhysidaFiles = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
    | where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where TargetFileName endswith ".rhysida" or TargetFileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"
    | extend Computer = DvcHostname
    | summarize EncTime = min(TimeGenerated),
                RenameCount = count(),
                NoteDropped = countif(TargetFileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"),
                EncProcess = any(ProcessName),
                EncProcessCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine),
                SampleFile = any(FilePath)
             by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
    | where RenameCount > 25 or NoteDropped > 0;
LogWipe
| join kind=inner RhysidaFiles on Computer
| where EncTime between (WipeTime .. WipeTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EncTime, WipeTime)
| project WipeTime, EncTime, DelaySec, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          WipeCmd, ParentProcessName,
          EncProcess, EncProcessCmd, RenameCount, NoteDropped, SampleFile
| order by WipeTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@Image:(*\wevtutil.exe OR *\Wevtutil.exe OR *\WEVTUTIL.EXE) OR @NewProcessName:(*\wevtutil.exe OR *\Wevtutil.exe OR *\WEVTUTIL.EXE)) @CommandLine:(*" cl "* AND (*Security* OR *System* OR *Application* OR *Setup*)) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\wevtutil\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\\s+cl\\s+", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)(Security|System|Application|Setup|Windows PowerShell)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/(\.rhysida$|CriticalBreachDetected\.pdf$)/i | groupBy([aid], function=[count(as=rename_count), max(_time, as=enc_time), collect([TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, SHA256HashData])]) | rename_count>25 OR TargetFileName=/CriticalBreachDetected\.pdf/i}, field=aid, key=aid, include=[enc_time, rename_count, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, SHA256HashData])
| eval delay_sec := enc_time - _time
| delay_sec >= 0 AND delay_sec < 1800
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ContextImageFileName, SHA256HashData, rename_count, delay_sec], function=count())

`Application` is not a column of SecurityEvent; it does exist on UrlClickEvents, IdentityLogonEvents, IdentityQueryEvents, IdentityDirectoryEvents, CloudAppEvents, AADSignInEventsBeta.
